[spoiler=Confusion causes escalation!][b][u]Astanir mainland:[/u][/b]
Whit the Argossian tribes brought back to the table ones more the Nordiheimians could breath a sigh of relife (for now), but it did not mean that their work was done when it came to getting the tribes to stay together.
While some information had been found about their history and past issues more investigation would have to continue, though the diplomatic agents could start their work with what had been found so far to try and find common ground and compromises that all the tribes could potentialy live with, somting that could provide an important start to build future trust upon.

An air mission was also launched to allow the Sui-mana tribe to have people physicaly attend the negotiations, a small, fast and agile aricraft was chosen for the jobb to as it would be much harder to detect and target, this aircraft had also been modefied to have a smaller signature then it would normaly have aswell as having flares and chaff launchers installed joust incase.
The mission would be monitored by 2 stealth observation UAVs and several wings of KJ-6G Kookaburra would be ready within range to defend it should it be needed, in addition the plane would fly a westward path with the least amount of enemy presence, based on information from the many infiltrators that Nordiheim had in the general area to further reduce the chance of detection, out to the ocean and then up north to the main Argossian area to avoid the active front lines.

The deliveries of material to the main Argossian area would also be given some better weapon systems, since the Democratic faction had been basicly taken over by a outside force it was not unlikely that they would be given aircraft to try and take sky dominance, and the Astanir National Forces could not be expected to not make a try at claiming the sky for the benefits that it could bring them in the conflict.
As such AA systems would be suplied to them;
Kangaroo MAMIVs with AAAMS-2B Valkyrie AA systems for short range protection, a bunch of the old but reliable Karlson 85MPT trucks with some of them being equiped with a mix of AAAMS-3A Shield maiden and Dual 105mm L/52 AA Module for medium range defence together with some Tyr-1 Automatic AA modules for missile point defence, all of them nice and mobile.
The few airfields that the Argossian militias had would also be prepped to be able to be used by KJ-5H Cockatoo fighters, these aircraft might be old but they had been heavily modernized to function as air interseptors that could target aircraft and missiles to contest the sky, the tribes were aproched to find out who of their people could be taken in to be trained in their use and if they would accept "volunteers", from the Argossian tribes in Nordiheim, to fly them while their own were trained.

The central enclave of Sui-mana would also not be forgoten, while it might be difficult to provide them with these heavier AA system there was one that could easely be air droped to them and used, the SA-10 AXS is a heavier infantry AA missile launcher that need 2 men to operate unlike the lighter SA-7 AXS but it have much longer range and is much more dangerous, this would hopefully provide them with a way of denying local enemies total air superiorety unless they desired to take on the losses of doing so.

Hopefully this would prove usefull in for the Argossian Militias on mainland Astanir.

[b][u]The island stronghold of the Armed Restoration Front:[/u][/b]

Nordiheim would manage to more or less figure out what the Armed restoration front was up to trough a mix of different sources and mettods;
>Their infiltrators would notefy them of the faction preparing some sort of naval task force for someting.
>The comunications that was intercepted by the Nordiheimians made it obvious that not only were they suspicious of the ships in the waters between their island and the Astanir mainland but they proberly knew that someone was obviusly helping the Argossian militias.
>And lastly their radar search for them with their supply run was rather obvios as their radar made them light up like a chrismass tree to the much more advanced Nordiheimian system.
This made it painfully obvious that they were planing to do someting, but what exactly were not entierly known, but Nordiheim comand decided to play the situation with a carefull hand joust in case as while the Armed restoration fronts equipment might be older then theirs it could still be dangerous if they had anyone competent comanding it while they underrestimated them in return.

The local ships would be gathered in two fleets;
>The small fleet (1 destroyers, 2 frigates, 1 cutter and 3 patrol boats defending) the COMINT ship as it performet its task would be reinforced with 1 of the Fenrir battleships in adition to 1 Sleipnir-Class Frigate to provide it with extra submarine defences pluss 1 cruise, 1 destroyer and 1 cutter, they would go into code yellow with submarine defences active and AA systems ready to go if any missiles would start comming towards them.
One wolf pack of 2 attack submarines would also stalk the waters bellow aswell.

>The rest of the ships would form a larger fleet with the 2 other battles ships together with 1 cruiser, 3 destroyers, 3 frigates, 3 cutters and 5 patroll boats, with a wolf pack of 2 attack submarines also stalking the waters bellow them to.
This fleet would be at standby to see how tings developed.

Lastly 2 stealth UAVs would be sendt to monitor the situation, 1 in the airspace of the island and one over the waters between the island and the smaller fleet with the COMINT ship.
The 12 stealth jets of Nordiheim, all that they had at this point, would all be stationed on military base on the small Nordiheim island that was closest to all of this joust in case together with other UAVs (2 stealth ones) and airplanes that might become necesary.

The submarines in Nordiheims home waters was also put in ready mode incase they would be so brash as try someting in that direction, tough this was more a protocol move.

If they were going to directly engage them it would be a foolish move by them, on the other hand if the Armed restoration front ended up joust doing a stand-off with them and look angrily at them it would ironicly be to their advantage as it would limmit the intell that Nordiheim could provide to the Argossian militias over time as they had been using their navy to do some of it, and sending more AWAC airplanes would actualy be somewhat difficult without weakening Nordiheims home defences, pealing away ships in suchh a situation wouldn't be ideal either.
As such Nordiheim comand hoped they didn't have someone in comand that could tink of such a ting.

[b][u]The attack on the two lower islands and a somewhat violent response:[/u][/b]

The detection of a unkown invasion fleet and its subseqvent attack on the Argossians on the islands would do noting but further complicate tings as it wasen't exactly expected even if they managed to detect them before they made landfall, the messages from the Argossians were noting more then redundant confirmation of what had joust unfolded.
Though identifying this fleet and the faction that it belonged to was much harder, they brandished a faction insignia that was compleatly unkown to the Nordiheimian HQ and seemed to use a inventory of weapons and vehicles that also was mostly unkown to them from what they could gather from fragmented intell that they coulden't trully trust, but it did not seem to be from Astanir.

It was swiftly desided that the attack from this unknown faction could not be accepted and seen as the direct invasion from a foreign nation on another nations land ((trough missunderstnading and not knowing who they actualy were)).

As such Nordiheim would launch "Operation Walanari" wich would consist of the following moves;
>The larger fleet with 2 battleships would move to place themselfs between the two lower islands and the direction that the invasion fleet seemed to have come from with operation code red, were all weapons and defences active and ready to go at a moments notice, both to treathen the invasion fleet with the battleships long range anti-ship missle payload (they curently have anti-ship missiles in 10 of their 15 VLS tubes) and to pose a problem for any logistics ships that is going to this hostile fleet.
>The 2 stealth UAVs would take to the air and start providing information and air targets for attacks.
>The 15 stealth fighters would form 5 wings of 3 aircraft each and use their advanced missile systems and stealth to pick apart any hostile aircrafts or missiles in the airzone of the two islands.
>The 3 Njord-Class Cruise missile Submarines together with launch sites in eastern Ostland would launch a barage of long range anti-ship cruise missiles, numbering about a hundred, at the invaiding fleet to get all of them away from the western side of the islands to clear a path for sending suplies.

>Then the  Argosian tribes there would be supplied with anit-air defences on the smaller island trough quick deliveries by Airheim SHH1-1C Sky Leviatan helicopter that would be guarded by Fighter escorts and stealth attack helicopers to prevent them from being shot down, these would bring in enough weapon systems to make 5 small mobile SAM teams were each would contain: 2x AAHAML-41 Module on Karlson 95MPT trucks, 5x AAAMS-3A Shield maidens on Karlson 85MPT truck with aditional mobile point defence systems to protect them together with "advisors" that would help the Argossians use the AA weapons effectivly.
There would also be sent Kangaroos with the  AAAMS-2B Valkyrie AA system and AC-4B AA2s to provide mobile AA defence for local forces, together with more weapons, vehilces and munitions to the Argossian defenders to replenish their losses including some more Iron Drake 2D tanks with ERA bricks for added protection.

Inn addition the stealth corvetes in Ostland and Nordland, aswell as the local attack submarines would be sendt to the small Nordiheimian island closest to all of this to provide defence for future events and operations.

The Nordiheimian could not only hope that this was all enough to save the Argossians on the two small islands from this hostile invasion and make the neceseary preparations to not only do further operations but most likely also to provide the local civilians with food, water and medical suplies as those were tings that would often get disrupted in a invasion and could turn out to be necesary.
[/spoiler]
[spoiler=New information and a change of plans]
[b][u]Supricing new information in the battle for the two lower islands[/u][/b]
Nordiheim command was rather baffeled by the new information that would quickly come in after their airforce had engaged the hostile aircraft in the lower islands airspace, the various surveilance, aswell as the advanced systems of the stealth fighters, had managed to atain a positive identification of who the aircraft belonged to.
The [b]PDF[/b], the military of Pantagruel itself, this made it easier to piece together who this unknown force, who went under the markings of [b]UDF[/b], actualy might be, the conclusion with the most agreement was that it most likely was the Amaralo People's Army, but why were they using a new insignia and doing joint military attacks with pantagruel that was so blatent and easy to see, had all pretence been thrown out the window?
Why were they doing someting this rash, had someting changed?

The minister of war, Grand general Thormod Thormodson III, saw someting ells tough, justification for their latest actions and a transformation of what it could be labbeled as.
Now they could claim that they were simply doing a intervention to defend another nation, who were within their sphere of influence, from a direct attack from a foreign nation and their litteral puppet trying to directly take advantage of a nation embroiled in a civil war.
With the local people on the island even asking Nordiheim for help to defend itself, ofcorse they had acted!
It also provided evidence to support the reports of Pantagruels attack and hostile takeover of the Amaralo People's Army earlier in the civil war and basicly stripped them of any pretence of that faction still being anyting other then under Pantagruels controll.

Thormod wasted no time ordering changes to the curent plans and orders of the Nordiheimian military;
>The invasion fleet were now to be crushed with the large fleet to its east and the assets to its west to converg on it and desimate it with the use of anti-ship missiles and torpedoes, it were to be gone imidiatly!
>The secound fleet with the COMINT ship were to no longer hold its possition and wait for the Armed Restoration Fronts action ageinst it, they would move out of their main shiping lane and towards the waters of Italian duch in the west/north-west and secure the shiping lanes there.
There was a chance that the Junta would use this suden move in their propaganda to proclaim that them joust "baring their teeth" had made a potential enemy flee from them to bolster moral and suport with their people, but this was someting they would joust have to take in stride as there was bigger fish to pay attention to right now.
It would also mean that they would need to be a bit more carefull with the supply ships going to the Argossians on Mainland Astanir, but any shortfall could most likely be covered by air on the airfields that was being expanded and improved in the Argossian tribal areas.
>There would be declared a "no fly zone" over and around the two lower islands to "protect" them from foreign attacks, the Pantagruel airforce would be faced with the warning that if they did not turn around they would be shot down.
>And lastly, gatter up a elite team to search for wreckage to use as aditional evidence, there were no way that none of the aircraft from Pantagruel was shot down by the stealth fighters and those aircraft pieces could be usefull to have as proof.

To help support Nordiheims "claims" of "aiding a nation in need ageinst another nation" the Nordiheim foreign office would get to work with what they allready had to make a solid case.
Both the reports of the blatant hostile takeover of the Amaralo People's Army by Pantagruel and the more direct proof, that was gathered by their different surveilance systems, that showed them in a joint attack ageinst the people of Astanirs lower islands would be used.
Any evidence of brutality provided by agents on the islands would also be used if it could be found.

[b][u]Destroying the invasion[/u][/b]

From both east and west forces from Nordiheim would converge on the invading fleet, when they got in range a large barage of anti-ship missiles would be fired from both directions to overwelm the AA defences of the ships and turn them into sinking wrecks.
In the sky both the stealth fighters and regular fighters would clear the sky of any remaining targets together with the AA systems that was being suplied to the local Argossians as fast as could be done, the large SHH1-1C Sky Leviatan would allow some of the smaller systems to be delivered ready for immidiate use.

Ones these two tasks were done the large fleet would take up position to help enforce the "no fly zone" together with the stealth fighters and other assets, any Pantagruel aircraft that would aproche would be given the ultimatum "If you enter this no fly zone you will be fired upon!".
Meanwhile high presicion missile and air strikes would be conducted on the invading forces that had landed on the islands using a combination of the local Argossians, Nordiheims agents and stealth UAVs that was monitoring the islands, any significant gattering of their forces would be targeted aswell as any rally point that was identified.
A EWJ-2 Curlew Electronic warfare airplane would also be called to the islands with a escort to disable the invaders ability to comunicate and organize themself.

One command were given tough, those of the UDF that laid down their weapons and surendered would be taken in and treated propperly according to the propper laws and regulations.
This would also be comunicated to the Argossian militias together with the explanation that it would help give their cause in the eyes of the world but also the other people of Astanir, someting that could be very beneficial to them.

[b][u]Mainland Astanir[/u][/b]

While tings were spicy over in the south-east there was also tings going on over in mainland Astanir.
With the Sui-mana being able to attend negotiations with representation physicaly present tings could hopefully continue going forward, but the Argossian tribes would also have to be told about the invasion.
The Nordiheimian diplomats there would inform them in full about what had happened and was going on over at the lower islands, with Pantagruel atempting an invasion together with their puppet faction and their vichious attacks on their fellow Argossians there.
This would also bring up a question, what was the situation of the representatives they sendt to Pentagruel?
Had they heard anyting back from them, or could they even comunicate with them at all?

They also cautioned them that the supply lines to them were not the most stable right now and as such some caution would be adviced, in adition the usualy very detailed military inteligence that they were being given would be slightly less so until more surveilance could be aranged trough such means as creating better airfields.

[b][u]The warning to the Sui-Mana Enclave[/u][/b]

The agents in and around the Sui-Mana enclave had reported back military movements that the Sui-mana had executed wich gave the Nordiheimian some cause of worry, spesificaly their recent classes with the Democratic Army of Astanir.
The front that they now were geting with them could potentialy endanger the enclave with the problem of having active and strong lines of engagements in all directions, with the added danger of attacks on the Democratic faction, if they even was that anymore, being incentiviced to do a large atack on them.
While they were somewhat busy right now it did not seem that it would last long, as such a change in the Sui-mana actions would need to happen to make them seem like less of a problem.

Nordiheim would comunicate this increasing danger to the Sui-mana leadership and point out that if they got targeted by both the Democratic and National forces they would undouptably be crushed and there would be rather little that they could do about it no matter how much weapons and supplies they airdropped to them.
As such they were heavely adviced to disengage from the Democratic forces and move out of their territory and back into their own, there they would be helped by the Nordiheimian agents to sett up defensive possitions and lines using the mines they had been given to make minefields  in an effort to make themselfs an uninviting target.
Hopefully the Democratic forces would see the Astaniran National Forces as a bether and more inviting target to attack instead.

If the Sui-mana needed a target to attack they should go for the National forces to, more spesificaly in the north-vestern direction as this would potentialy bring them closer to their fellow Argossian brothers and sisters, wich could eventualy create the opportunity to join the territories together as one and eliminate perhaps their greatest challenge to achive their goal.

Now the Nordiheimian would have to wait and hope that they had erned enough trust and good will with the Sui-mana and the other Argossians for them to listen to their advice and counceling.[/spoiler]

[/quote]

[quote=pantagruel;60417404][spoiler][i]The warships now appeared on the radar of the gliding F-15s. Their decision to attack the smaller gunboats had been foolish; survivors were able to relay their positions into the F-15s' data systems. The aircraft began a full-scale process of computing and translating that data into coordinates, which were passed to local GPS-III satellites loitering thousands of kilometers above the battlefield. The satellites correlated mapped infrared and radar returns across the maritime canvas, confirmed the ships' positions, and relayed the information back to the F-15s. With full awareness of the new targets, the F-15s initiated a counterattack to shift the tempo of the battle. Their AGM-158C LRASMs provided an ideal solution. The missiles separated from the aircraft, glided away until they reached a safe distance from the F-15s, then ignited their motors and streaked toward the naval targets.

With Tribal defenses softened, the UDF advanced toward their objective, but each gain stretched their lines. Guerrilla tactics and sniper ambushes forced UDF forces to fall back to central rallying points where they could better engage the more sophisticated tribal units. The attacking squadrons noticed that tribal tanks concentrated on defending checkpoints, so they used small loitering drones to locate those clusters. The drones then guided 9M117 Bastion anti-armor missiles into the Tribal terrain until the missiles found their targets.

When tribal forces proved unwilling to negotiate, the UDF shifted to a policy of total annihilation, employing all available means to neutralize resistance. Occupation forces observed that Argossian tribes continued to fight after missile strikes and bombings, so they called in another squadron of Aardvarks to finish destroying the positions. Information flowed carefully between units as Aardvarks lifted from airstrips across the southern archipelago and screamed toward tribal forces with an even heavier payload aimed at eliminating the remaining resistance.

There was to be no waiting, the UDF knew taking the initiative was key in ending the tribes as soon as possible. [/i][/spoiler][/quote]

[b]Argossian Negotiations[/b]
With all the mainland tribes on the negotiating table, progress would finally start to make itself evident. News of the battles unfolding in the south and the east would motive the argossians to find a common ground, with the following being proposed to Nordiheim.
[list]
- The Argossian tribes of the mainland will unite their territories into a singular state, which will go by the name of "The tribal republic of Kuhaw-Astan"
- This state will act as a federation, allowing each tribe autonomy over a range of affairs and allowing each tribal leader a say in the government
- The military of this state will be split into units, with a unit being dedicated to a specific tribe. This will allow far more effective communication on the battle field and will allow each tribe to preserve their military traditions
- Nordiheim will provide this state with military equipment for the duration of the war and afterwards, unless the agreements made at this table are violated by either side
- Nordiheim will protect this state from unwanted external influence and harm, both military and economic, for the duration of the war and afterwards, unless the agreements made at this table are violated by either side
[/list]

Unaware of the enemy they were facing, the sui-mana would use the Nordiheimian equipment to continue their push against the Democrats, however they would not make much progress and eventually the democrats would begin to push them back. After several calls from Nordiheim, the Sui-mana leadership would eventually stand down and withdraw, focusing their forces against the nationalists in the south.

When questioned about communication with the cheiftains, the tribes would come up blank. No communications had been made since they were notified of their arrival in teremok, which has prompted great suspicion about the councils.

[b]The stronghold island[/b]
After the Nordiheimians had been surveying off the coast of the stronghold island for the past fews days, The Restorationists would launch their naval task force to confront Nordiheim, consisting of the following:
[list]
- 1 submarine
- 5 frigates
- 3 destroyers
-2 cruisers

They would fire upon Nordiheim as soon as they came into view.
[/list]

[b]The lower islands[/b]
The antiair defences would be set up as quickly as possible and targeted at the incoming F-15s and their payloads. Apart from this, the argossians would not have any other counters to the F-15s, nor any of the incoming missiles. In the sea, the argossian's own ships would be quickly worn down by the join forces of the UDF and the PDF's airborn bombardments.

The main defence would have to be left to the Nordiheimians, whilst the Argossians would retire to the island and begin to engage in guerilla tactics, which would most likely allow the UDF to make a landing. The guerilla tactics would at first be dealt with by the UDF by rallying into central positions, but argossian snipers would easily be able to pick them off like this by hiding in the tall, untouched grasses of the islands. Once the numbers of the large gatherings had been reduced, the main forces would move in to surround them, easily outnumbering them at this point.

(tbh not much for me to say here, from this point onwards Nordiheimian forces will be doing most of the air and naval fighting.)

[b]Change of Leadership in the restoration front[/b]
after months of disjointed fighting, a new set of leaders have finally risen up in the armed restoration front to fill the vacant seats of the military council. Thew new council members are:
[list]
- General Akuini
- General Saloa
- General Loni
[/list]

[b]11th February 2026 - Formal Resignation of Kaplan Zorlu[/b]

This morning, Kaplan Zorlu announced his formal resignation from the position of chairman of the Social Unity Party, currently the largest opposition party to the conservatives. This comes after the party lost this years election, losing their 3-decade long consistent grip on power.

The new chairman, Hakan Bozkahn has announced a few reforms to the partys policies and his views for the future of the country. 

His reforms include taking a more peaceful approach to world affairs, opting to build trade and cooperation with the globe, whilst maintaining current ties. He has also announced a stronger emphasis on regional cooperation, including increased participation in SSP talks and the implementation of the North-South east shamatine transport program, in conjunction with Srpka and Karcovshkie. However, whilst recognising the need for peaceful cooperation, he has also announced several draft budgets which would divert spending away from special forces and to the navy and air force, after several inquiries have been made into the issues made evident in these branches by the THEP-EDU war.

Hakans view for the countrys future mainly incorporates these reformed policies. He has heavily criticised the current government for signing an unfair deal with the Neue Republik, stating that we need to build our future on trade, not force. This country needs fair trade deals with our allies and our adversaries alike to promote a better, connected future, but this wont come by signing deals like our current one with the Republik.

Overall, most have viewed this change of leadership positive, but Hydronia is yet to see what the future will hold
